## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

# Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt. Ltd.

Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's premier providers of integrated
clinical research solutions, with a state-of-the-art operational facility based in Pune,
Maharashtra, Hyderabad, Telangana.We proudly serve a diverse clientele across the biopharmaceutical,
herbal, nutraceutical, medical device, and generic pharmaceutical sectors.

###### ABOUT US

Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt Ltd is one of India’s leading providers of integrated clinical
research services having operational facilities in Pune, MH, Hyderabad, Telangana, India followed by
Operations can be executed in Malaysia, Philippines, Dubai, Vietnam, part of Europe region as well.
We have been successfully serving to a wide range of clientele comprising of biopharmaceutical,
Herbal, Neutraceutical, Device companies and generic drug industry.

Our broad spectrum of superior quality services are designed to meet our customers’ specific needs.
The team of experts at Ardent offers management and leadership solutions to clinical researchers to
ensure that their project starts on the right foot. Apart from a timely start, an efficient
execution and delivery of clinical trial projects is ascertained.

We’re equipped with ICH GCP, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and all our clinical trial
activities strictly comply with the regulatory principles and guidelines. As we conform to the
highest standards of ethics, the patients under investigation can rest assured about their safety
and confidentiality.

With our exhaustive investigator database and technical expertise in diverse areas of therapeutic
research, we enable faster patient recruitment, cost-effective trials and a world-class clinical
support. But what really sets us apart from our peers is our quick turnaround times and the personal
attention, we pay to our customers.

##### Our Mission

At Ardent Clinical Research Services, our mission is to provide a reliable and supportive ecosystem
for clinical trials, experimental research, and observational studies. We tailor each project to the
specific needs of our clients, aiming to address the growing global burden of disease and the
escalating demand for innovation in pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

commit

##### Our Vision

We envision a future where Ardent plays a pivotal role not just in the development of new drugs,
diagnostics, and therapeutic approaches, but also in shaping the broader healthcare landscape. Our
goal is to contribute meaningfully to healthcare planning, promote the continuous evaluation of
medical practices, and enhance the overall quality of care through a deep and data-driven
understanding of risk factors and health outcomes.

##### Our Core Values

## What ARDENT Stands For

At Ardent Clinical Research Services, our name embodies the values we live by every day. Each letter
of “ARDENT” reflects a foundational principle that drives our commitment to excellence in clinical
research.

A

##### A – Attention to Detail

We ensure meticulous attention to every detail, carefully reviewing and understanding client
requirements to deliver precise and reliable results.

R

##### R – Responsibility

We uphold our responsibility to society and the people we serve, believing that ethical conduct and
social awareness are marks of a truly good organization.

D

##### D – Diversity

Our team is made up of individuals from diverse backgrounds and regions across India, fostering
inclusive growth and innovation.

E

##### E – Excellence

We strive for excellence not by doing different things, but by doing things differently—with
innovation, quality, and integrity at the core.

N

##### N – Nobility

We are guided by noble values and strong ethics, which we uphold proudly in every aspect of our
organizational culture.

T

##### T – Teamwork

We believe in absolute teamwork. Our culture supports and encourages participation and feedback at
all levels, ensuring collaboration across all functions.

### Mr. Chandu Gangadhar Devanpally

#### Founder & CEO

Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt. Ltd.

Mr. Chandu Gangadhar Devanpally is the visionary Founder and CEO of Ardent Clinical Research
Services Pvt. Ltd. He holds a Postgraduate degree in Biochemistry and a Diploma in Clinical Research
from Nagpur, Maharashtra.

Mr. Devanpally began his career in 2007 in the Department of Clinical Trials at Sushrut Hospital and
Research Center, Nagpur. Since then, he has built a dynamic and diverse career in the clinical
research industry, working across multiple roles such as Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC),
Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Quality Manager, and Operations Manager for both domestic and
global clinical trials.

A meticulous and goal-oriented entrepreneur, he has not only contributed to clinical research but
has also successfully launched various ventures across different industries. His hands-on experience
spans end-to-end clinical trial project management, data management, monitoring, business
development, and sponsor/vendor communications.

Mr. Devanpally is a keen strategist with a deep understanding of the evolving research landscape. He
brings strong capabilities in protocol-based trial management, team leadership, and training of
subordinates, making him a key driving force behind Ardent's growth and reputation.

With outstanding communication, relationship management, and organizational skills, he continues to
lead Ardent Clinical Research Services with a commitment to quality, innovation, and ethical
excellence in clinical trials.

# bioaccess® — Submission-ready first-in-human data in 12 months — before your runway runs out

bioaccess® runs first-in-human and early-feasibility studies across Latin America under ISO 14155,
anchored to your U.S. FDA strategy — conducted under good clinical practice (ISO 14155) so the
resulting data is eligible for FDA acceptance under 21 CFR 812.28 — acceptance is determined by FDA
on a submission-by-submission basis and ready for your next raise. Co-founded in 2010 by Dr. Pedro
Martinez-Clark, Dr. William O'Neill, and Julio G. Martinez-Clark.

## The 12-Month FIH Guarantee

We put your protocol-to-last-patient-last-visit timeline in writing. If we miss it for reasons
within our control, we credit 100% of our project-management and monitoring fees until LPLV — you
don't pay us to be late. Full terms in your proposal.

## From protocol to outcome — 9 client programs
* [PAVmed (PortIO)][1] — Vascular Access, Colombia — first-in-human PortIO™ intraosseous infusion
  program; results published in the Journal of Vascular Access. PortIO relaunched within PAVmed's
  device portfolio in 2026 (investigational; no FDA clearance implied).
* [ReGelTec (HYDRAFIL®)][2] — Spine / Orthopedics, Colombia & Panama — OUS data (75 patients) → CE
  Mark + FDA IDE pivotal trial (first U.S. patient Jun 2025, 225-patient RCT); peer-reviewed results
  in Pain Physician, Jan 2026.
* [enVVeno Medical (enVVe®)][3] — Vascular Surgery, Colombia — LATAM first-in-human foundation →
  first-ever FDA IDE approval for a non-surgical replacement venous valve; U.S. pivotal TAVVE® study
  authorized April 29, 2026. The IDE authorizes the pivotal STUDY in severe deep chronic venous
  insufficiency, not device clearance or approval.
* [Axoft][4] — Neurotechnology, Panama — Panama first-in-human at The Panama Clinic (4 patients
  implanted during brain-tumor resection) → 11 patients implanted worldwide → $55M Series A (April
  2026, led by C.P. Group Innovation; >$60M total raised). FDA Breakthrough Device Designation
  (2022).
* [Mitralign][5] — Structural Heart, Colombia & Brazil — percutaneous mitral annuloplasty program
  advanced in LATAM (company later acquired by Edwards Lifesciences).
* [OcuMedex (Vizio™ Aqueous Microshunt)][6] — Ophthalmology, Colombia — first-in-human clinical
  trials of the Vizio™ Aqueous Microshunt for glaucoma. Investigational device that drains aqueous
  humor from the anterior chamber to the eye's surface for IOP reduction; currently in human
  clinical trials (no FDA clearance implied).
* [Newrotex (SilkAxons™)][7] — Peripheral Nerve Repair, Panama — world's first SilkAxons™
  implantation at The Panama Clinic (FIH began August 2025); investigational silk-based nerve guide
  intended for large-gap peripheral nerve injuries beyond the reach of existing conduits.
* [Watershed Therapeutics][8] — Urology / Drug Delivery, El Salvador & Panama (earlier support in
  Colombia) — bioaccess® secured regulatory and ethics-committee approvals to conduct clinical
  studies of Watershed's novel intravesical bladder-targeted drug-delivery platform (rUTIs,
  overactive bladder, bladder cancer). Investigational; no FDA clearance or approval implied.
* [Avantec Vascular (a Nipro Company)][9] — Cardiovascular / Vascular / Venous, El Salvador, Mexico
  & Colombia — bioaccess® ran the first-in-human / early clinical studies of Avantec's Sangria™
  Venous Remodeling System across El Salvador, Mexico, and Colombia (PI/site selection,
  ministry-of-health regulatory dossier submissions to authorize study conduct, $10M clinical-trial
  insurance, device importation, and FIH execution). Sangria™ is investigational; no FDA clearance,
  approval, CE marking, or commercialization implied.

*Eligibility of foreign clinical data for FDA submission does not constitute or predict FDA
clearance, approval, or acceptance of any specific application.*

## Core Proof Points
* 50+ client companies accelerated since 2010
* 50+ pre-qualified clinical trial sites
* 19 Latin American & Caribbean countries covered
* Ethics-committee approval in a median of 4–8 weeks; the comparable U.S. pathway (IDE + IRB + site
  activation to first patient) typically runs 6–12 months
* Meaningful per-patient savings compared to US/EU trials (experience-based estimate)
* ACRP-certified clinical research team

## Services

    data and safety monitoring, risk‑based quality control, patient recruitment, budget and supply
    management, and decentralized trial integration to leadership and ethical cultural competency to
    ensure patient safety, data integrity, and regulatory compliance throughout the trial lifecycle.

    self‑paced; 110 CPD hours over 4–12 weeks; start anytime.
  * **Accreditation:** CPD‑accredited; Earn ACE College Credit.
  * **Certification Requirements:** ≥ 70% on final exam (up to two attempts); online certificate
    awarded upon passing.
  * **Graduates work at:** Pharmaceutical and Biotech Companies, Hospitals and Healthcare Providers,
    Universities and Academic Institutions, Clinical Research and Consulting Services, Diagnostic

# APAC Based Global CRO
# Driven by Science, Defined by Excellence

Emerald Clinical Trials is a global leader in clinical research, partnering with over 160 biotech
companies and 15 of the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical firms. Headquartered in Singapore, we combine
scientific excellence with operational expertise to deliver end-to-end clinical trial solutions
across all phases, offering Phase I-IV and real-world studies.

With over two decades of experience and a world-renowned focus in renal research, Emerald Clinical
has helped drive medical breakthroughs through deep scientific insight, flawless execution, and an
unwavering commitment to quality.

## More Than a CRO. Your Global Scientific Partner

With over 25 years of experience and world‑renowned renal expertise, Emerald Clinical combines deep
scientific insight with flawless execution to accelerate smarter development across renal, oncology,
cardiometabolic, and early‑phase research. From our Asia‑Pacific base, our global teams across
China, EMEA, and the Americas partner with leading investigators and KOLs to turn complex research
into real results—going beyond execution to lead studies and help deliver life‑changing therapies
worldwide.

[CLINICAL TRIALS BUILT FOR YOU][107]

## Where Expertise Meets Acceleration

From our Asia-Pacific base, we unite global teams across China, EMEA, and the Americas, partnering
with top investigators and KOL networks to drive faster, smarter development in renal, oncology,
cardiometabolic, and early-phase research.

## Your Global Partner with APAC Expertise

Headquartered in Singapore, Emerald Clinical is located across the Asia-Pacific region, Europe and
the United States of America. We also provide services in Japan, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Thailand,
Central Eastern Europe and Latin America

Partner with a CRO that combines worldwide reach with deep Asia-Pacific expertise.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

## The Entire Clinical Data Lifecycle.

Providers face relentless pressure to do more with less. Fragmented systems, data quality gaps, and

MRO helps you capture, abstract, structure, validate, connect, analyze, and activate your clinical
data across every system and use case.

### Visibility

Clinical data moves across systems, sites, and requesters. Without visibility, every gap is a risk.

### Quality

Incomplete or inaccurate data creates compliance exposure and undermines downstream decisions.

### Fragmentation

When clinical data lives in silos, leaders can’t act on it. The full picture stays out of reach.

### Costs

Most health systems treat clinical data operations as a cost center.

### Full Transparency.

Real-time tracking and system-wide transparency, so you always know where your data is and what it’s

## VISION

Developing Better Solutions For Physicians And Patients

Neuraptive is developing novel therapeutics and medical products to address the unmet needs of
physicians and patients impacted by peripheral nerve injuries.

[Illustration of the human arm anatomy representing nerves, bones and ligaments..jpg]

## RESEARCH & TECHNOLOGY

The Future of Peripheral Nerve Repair and Recovery

### PEG-FUSION 

Neuraptive has in-licensed technology from the University of Texas at Austin (UT) protecting a novel
fusion system for repairing severed peripheral nerves. This technology improves both the speed and
outcomes of peripheral nerve injuries (PNI).

[Learn More][13]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 1 Nerve Fusion.png]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 2 Drug Delivery Device.png]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 2 Drug Delivery Device.png]

### DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE

A specialized device focusing on the delivery of active agents for topical administration directly
on the nerve.

[Learn More][14]

### MICROSURGICAL INSTRUMENTS

Neuraptive is developing nerve-specific microsurgical instruments that address current product
limitations in the field of nerve repair.

[Learn More][15]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 3 Microsurgical Instruments.png]
[clinic, profession, people, healthcare and medicine concept - group of medics or doctors w]

## THE NEURAPTIVE DIFFERENCE

An innovative technology potentially revolutionizing nerve repair.

Neuraptive has developed a surgical treatment kit for peripheral nerves after traumas or peripheral
nerve reconstruction procedures.  NTX-001 leverages the 505(b)(2) development pathway (comprised of
previously approved pharmaceutical ingredients) presented in sterile solutions.

[Read More][16]

### Our
### Partner

The in-licensed and issued patent estate from the University of Texas protects the method of

kit design for which separate patent applications have been filed. Patent protections is expected to
extend through 2038.

[Phoenix CTMS]

Phoenix CTMS is a modern web application combining capabilities of database software used in
clinical research in *one* modular system.
* PRS (Patient Recruitment System)
* CTMS (Clinical Trial Management System)
* CDMS (Clinical Data Management System) – EDC (Electronic Data Capture) Package

This unmatched feature set is geared to support all operational and regulatory requirements of the
clinical front end in academic research, at CROs (Contract Research Organisations) and hospitals
conducting clinical studies of any phase.

After years of collaborative development with trial sites at the [Medical University of Graz][21],
the Phoenix CTMS now becomes publicly available ([LGPL 2.1][22]). It could be the perfect choice if
you e.g.
* need a private, *encrypted* subject registry for PII (personally identifyable information), to
  complement your existing CDMS
* need a solution to comply with upcoming [EU-GDPR][23] (General Data Protection Regulation)
* want to operate a secure online *signup portal* for subject candidates
* must not store the sensitive data in the *cloud*
* are not satisfied with the edit check or form field calculation possibilities available in other
  EDC packages
* want a CDMS that gives you unlimited *Javascript* form scripting support (server- and browserside)
* need to deal with *large* eCRFs (electronic case report forms)
* want to try a serious open source alternative for eCRFs
* need to formulate complex *ad-hoc* database queries to list matching subject candidates using *set
  operations*
* conduct several trials in parallel and need to organize site staff and resources
* need a software to implement various processes for ICH GCP (good clinical practice) compliance
* want a turn-key system that’s operational out-of-the-box, instead of integrating multiple systems

With **11 offices** across Europe, we deliver comprehensive clinical development and consulting
services focused on **cost efficiency, rapid timelines, and top-quality results**. Our established
global partnerships ensure we meet and exceed industry benchmarks, driving success in every phase of
clinical research.

## About Us

Founded in 1996 as the SIRO Research Foundation and incorporated in 2000 as SIRO Clinpharm Private
Limited, SIRO brings over two decades of exceptional project management expertise to the table. From
pioneering proof-of-concept trials to managing complex, multinational studies involving rare
diseases, stringent protocols, and accelerated timelines, SIRO has consistently delivered with
precision and reliability. Our win-win philosophy drives us to ensure success for every client.
Today, SIRO stands as a leading provider of drug development and discovery solutions, offering a
diverse and innovative suite of CRO services to global biotech, pharmaceutical, medical device, and
academic institutions. To better serve our clients’ evolving needs, we have strategically
reorganized into three specialized verticals: SIRO Clintech, SIRO Medical Writing, and SIRO
Clinpharm, which continues to offer specialized FSP services.

[Learn more][52]
[SPUTNIK LIGHT, THE FIRST COMPONENT OF SPUTNIK V, IS A SAFE AND EFFECTIVE STAND-ALONE ONE-SHOT
VACCINE AGAINST COVID-19 AND AN IDEAL BOOSTER][53]
* Efficacy against infection of over 80%
* Efficacy as a stand-alone vaccine against infection by Delta - 70%
* Efficacy in the age group below 60 – over 75%
* Efficacy against hospitalisation and severe disease is even higher
[Learn more][54]
[INVITATION FOR INTERNATIONAL SCIENTISTS AND SCIENTIFIC INSTITUTIONS TO COOPERATE ON RESEARCH OF
REAL-WORLD DATA/REAL-WORLD EVIDENCE (RWD/RWE) ON SAFETY AND EFFICACY OF CORONAVIRUS VACCINES][55]

The Russian Direct Investment Fund is inviting independent international researchers and scientific
institutions to cooperate on real-world studies of safety and efficacy of coronavirus vaccines,
including Sputnik V, Sputnik Light and others.

[Learn more][56]
[OFFICIAL DATA ON SPUTNIK V AROUND THE WORLD][57]

On the first anniversary of Sputnik V registration official data from leading countries confirms the
vaccine’s high safety and efficacy profile.

[Learn more][58]
[SCIENTIFIC STUDIES ON SPUTNIK V AND SPUTNIK LIGHT VACCINES][59]

The safety and efficacy of Sputnik V and Sputnik Light was confirmed by numerous publications in the
leading international scientific journals including The Lancet and Vaccines.

[Learn more][60]
[Proven vector technology based on human adenovirus][61]

The use of adenovirus vector technology for vector vaccines has been gaining momentum since the
1980s, and is safe and effective, which has been proven in multiple studies.

[Learn more][62]
[About gamaleya national center][63]

The Gamaleya National Center of Epidemiology and Microbiology is the world’s leading research
institution founded in 1891.

The center runs one of the unique “virus libraries” in the world and has its own vaccine production
facility. Gamaleya Research Center has recently received an international patent for Ebola vaccine
using adenovirus vector.

[Learn more][64]
[Clinical trials][65]

The vaccine has received a registration certificate from the Russian Ministry of Health and under
emergency rules adopted during the COVID-19 pandemic can be used to vaccinate the population in
Russia. Sputnik V is one of the three vaccines in the world with efficacy of over 90%. Sputnik V’s
efficacy was validated by internationally peer reviewed data published in [The Lancet][66].

[Learn more][67]
[Partnerships][68]

Russia is open to international cooperation in combating the global threat of the COVID-19 pandemic
and other future epidemics. We are actively cooperating with more than 14 countries producing our
vaccine abroad, including India, China, Brazil, Mexico, Egypt, Iran, Italy, South Korea, Argentina,
Kazakhstan, the Republic of Belarus, Serbia, Turkey, Vietnam, etc. We are looking forward to new
partners willing to join this initiative and help us save lives.

Timetoast is a free online timeline maker for work, school, and personal use. Plan projects, teach
lessons, map life events, and share interactive timelines that are easy to follow.

Used by **millions worldwide** for product launches, roadmaps, lessons, biographies, and historical
overviews.

Vita Global Sciences’ comprehensive suite of offerings includes clinical data management,
cutting-edge technology solutions, and robust compliance support encompassing quality assurance,
validation processes, and regulatory guidance. Additionally, we offer expert clinical operations
management to ensure efficient trial execution. With a deep understanding of the complexities of

Clinical Ops

Effective Clinical Operations are the cornerstone of successful drug development. Our dedicated team
of professionals is attuned to the critical nuances that drive clinical trial success, from
meticulous protocol adherence to proactive risk management. We prioritize precision and compliance
at every stage, ensuring your trials proceed with maximum efficiency and regulatory confidence.
[ Learn More [Arrow-Blue-Off] ][42]

Clinical Data Management

At Vita Global Sciences, we understand that the importance of clinical data assets in
pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device industry. Our expert team is committed to ensuring that
your clinical trial data management process: 1) fits your project needs, 2) is highly efficient, and
3) meets the highest standards of integrity and quality by complying with Good Clinical Data
Management Practices (GCDMP) and Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDSIC)
requirements. A team of highly experienced data managers will support all CDM-aspects of our
project, individual trial databases are developed according to your business requirements, data is
being consequently monitored and validated prior to transfer to the formulation level.


Our core competencies in data management comes from our thorough knowledge of standards, our
flexible systems, and the effective use of vividly available data management systems.

[ Learn More [Arrow-Blue-Off] ][43]

Biostatistics

Vita Global Sciences has developed a network of statisticians who are at the cutting-edge of advance
statistical design and analysis, with in-depth expertise across therapeutic areas. Irrespective of
where you are in the product development lifecycle and approval process, Vita Global Sciences can
provide you with the strategic consulting needed in performing/optimizing the trial design and
developing a statistical analysis plan which will detail the safety and efficacy analysis methods
required for securing marketing approval. We also have ample experience in representing the customer
at regulatory body meetings. Our Biostatistics team offers services on complex statistical issues
encountered during study design or analysis. They bring expertise and insights in trial design,
sample size calculations, randomization, interim analyses, developing complex statistical analysis
plans (SAPs), and consulting on adaptive design. They have extensive experience in interacting with
FDA and are actively collaborating with academia, industry and FDA working groups.
[ Learn More [Arrow-Blue-Off] ][44]

Statistical Programming

Vita Global Sciences has expert programmers in the areas of SAS, R, and Python who tactfully and
efficiently handle clinical trial data to provide automated outputs in accordance with industry and
regulatory standards. Our team quickly adapts client specific technologies and best practices and
provides insightful analysis and clinical study reports that empowers clients to draw
interpretations and make well-informed decisions. A clearly laid out QC procedure helps us to
deliver results on time, and with utmost quality.

## FAQ:

### Why do I need a wiki?

For info that you need to access often, keep up-to-date, share, or collaborate on, a wiki performs
better than alternative tools.  Wikis are a great solution when people get frustrated that notes are
too scattered, documents lack organization, and digging through emails is a pain.

Check out our demos for examples of how wikis are great for [retaining institutional knowledge][18],
[tracking personal information][19], [organizing creative projects][20], and [beyond][21].

### Will my wikis be secure and private?

Yes and yes — you have complete control over who can view and collaborate on your wikis.

Got a recipe wiki that you want to share widely?  Make it public for anyone to view. 
Created a wiki for an upcoming trip?  Only grant access to the folks traveling with you. 
Outlining your plans for the Great American Novel?  Keep the wiki private and for-your-eyes-only. 
You can make each wiki as public or as private as you want.

### Can I change plans later?

Yes.  You can upgrade or downgrade your account at any time.

### What happens to my content if I cancel my account?

We hope that you'll love Wikiful and will want to keep your wikis alive and thriving. 
But if you decide to close your account, you can use the "Export Wiki" feature to save a copy
of your wiki's content to your computer.

# Welcome To WJPR!                                                                                  
                                                                                                    
**WJPR** is a worldwide multidisciplinary, monthly published, open access, peer-reviewed, online    
pharmacy journal. The aim of WJPR is to serve as a means for updating the scientific knowledge of   
the international audience in the pharmaceutical forum.                                             
                                                                                                    
The Journal welcomes the original research articles, review, short communications and case studies  
relevant to the various fields of Pharmaceutical Sciences such as; Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical    
Technology, Biopharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Analysis and Quality         
Assurance, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmacology and Toxicology, Pharmacy Practice includes Hospital    
Community and Clinical Pharmacy, Pharmacognosy and Phytochemistry, Pharmaceutical Microbiology and  
Biotechnology, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmaceutical Marketing Research, and Alternative Medicines. 
                                                                                                    
##### Journal Standards                                                                             
* A broad ranging open access online journal.                                                       
* Eminent editorials from thought out the world.                                                    
* Fast online manuscript submission.                                                                
* Rapid publication high visibility.                                                                
* Our journal indexed in different reputed publisher databases.                                     
* Gives Email/SMS alert updates.

# Empowering Excellence in Clinical Data Management 

The Association for Clinical Data Management (ACDM) represents a vibrant community of dedicated
clinical research professionals who are passionate about enhancing the drug development process. We
foster an environment that encourages continuous learning and the practical application of modern
Clinical Data Management practices.

With over 30 years of service to the data management community, our unwavering commitment is to
provide clear and effective platforms for our members to network, share experiences, and stay
abreast of the latest regulations and standards in Clinical Data Management. We are equally proud to
support our members on their professional development journeys, offering opportunities to gain the
skills and insights needed to excel in their careers and shape the future of data management.

At the hub of ACDM’s activities, our website serves as a rich and diverse resource hub, catering to
professionals at all levels of expertise in clinical data management. Whether you are just starting
your career or are an experienced expert, ACDM provides the tools, knowledge, and connections to
help you thrive in this dynamic field.

# Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt. Ltd.

Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's premier providers of integrated
clinical research solutions, with a state-of-the-art operational facility based in Pune,
Maharashtra, Hyderabad, Telangana.We proudly serve a diverse clientele across the biopharmaceutical,
herbal, nutraceutical, medical device, and generic pharmaceutical sectors.

###### ABOUT US

Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt Ltd is one of India’s leading providers of integrated clinical
research services having operational facilities in Pune, MH, Hyderabad, Telangana, India followed by
Operations can be executed in Malaysia, Philippines, Dubai, Vietnam, part of Europe region as well.
We have been successfully serving to a wide range of clientele comprising of biopharmaceutical,
Herbal, Neutraceutical, Device companies and generic drug industry.

Our broad spectrum of superior quality services are designed to meet our customers’ specific needs.
The team of experts at Ardent offers management and leadership solutions to clinical researchers to
ensure that their project starts on the right foot. Apart from a timely start, an efficient
execution and delivery of clinical trial projects is ascertained.

We’re equipped with ICH GCP, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and all our clinical trial
activities strictly comply with the regulatory principles and guidelines. As we conform to the
highest standards of ethics, the patients under investigation can rest assured about their safety
and confidentiality.

With our exhaustive investigator database and technical expertise in diverse areas of therapeutic
research, we enable faster patient recruitment, cost-effective trials and a world-class clinical
support. But what really sets us apart from our peers is our quick turnaround times and the personal
attention, we pay to our customers.

##### Our Mission

At Ardent Clinical Research Services, our mission is to provide a reliable and supportive ecosystem
for clinical trials, experimental research, and observational studies. We tailor each project to the
specific needs of our clients, aiming to address the growing global burden of disease and the
escalating demand for innovation in pharmaceuticals and medical devices.

understanding of risk factors and health outcomes.

### Mr. Chandu Gangadhar Devanpally

#### Founder & CEO

Ardent Clinical Research Services Pvt. Ltd.

Mr. Chandu Gangadhar Devanpally is the visionary Founder and CEO of Ardent Clinical Research
Services Pvt. Ltd. He holds a Postgraduate degree in Biochemistry and a Diploma in Clinical Research
from Nagpur, Maharashtra.

Mr. Devanpally began his career in 2007 in the Department of Clinical Trials at Sushrut Hospital and
Research Center, Nagpur. Since then, he has built a dynamic and diverse career in the clinical
research industry, working across multiple roles such as Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC),
Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Quality Manager, and Operations Manager for both domestic and
global clinical trials.

A meticulous and goal-oriented entrepreneur, he has not only contributed to clinical research but
has also successfully launched various ventures across different industries. His hands-on experience
spans end-to-end clinical trial project management, data management, monitoring, business
development, and sponsor/vendor communications.

Mr. Devanpally is a keen strategist with a deep understanding of the evolving research landscape. He
brings strong capabilities in protocol-based trial management, team leadership, and training of
subordinates, making him a key driving force behind Ardent's growth and reputation.

With outstanding communication, relationship management, and organizational skills, he continues to
lead Ardent Clinical Research Services with a commitment to quality, innovation, and ethical
excellence in clinical trials.

# Artificial Intelligence & Bioinformatics for Precision Medicine

Derisk your pipeline by transforming biological complexity into the decisions that drive drug
discovery success. 

## Welcome to Ardigen,
## where innovation meets proficiency in the realm of AI-driven drug discovery and development.

Ardigen was founded in 2015 with a bold vision: to harness the power of Artificial Intelligence to
transform drug discovery and development.

We understand the challenges biotech and pharmaceutical companies face: long timelines, high costs,
and significant risks. Our mission is to tackle these challenges head-on by turning biomedical data
into actionable insights – enhancing success rates in drug discovery and development while
accelerating the path from research to patient care

Ardigen is your trusted AI-powered CRO partner in the mission to bring life-saving medicines to
market, offering **end-to-end AI-driven solutions.**

You will get a strong conclusion that covers each aspect of the challenge with a multidisciplinary

### Innovative AI Solutions

# bioaccess® — Submission-ready first-in-human data in 12 months — before your runway runs out

bioaccess® runs first-in-human and early-feasibility studies across Latin America under ISO 14155,
anchored to your U.S. FDA strategy — conducted under good clinical practice (ISO 14155) so the
resulting data is eligible for FDA acceptance under 21 CFR 812.28 — acceptance is determined by FDA
on a submission-by-submission basis and ready for your next raise. Co-founded in 2010 by Dr. Pedro
Martinez-Clark, Dr. William O'Neill, and Julio G. Martinez-Clark.

## The 12-Month FIH Guarantee

We put your protocol-to-last-patient-last-visit timeline in writing. If we miss it for reasons
within our control, we credit 100% of our project-management and monitoring fees until LPLV — you
don't pay us to be late. Full terms in your proposal.

## From protocol to outcome — 9 client programs
* [PAVmed (PortIO)][1] — Vascular Access, Colombia — first-in-human PortIO™ intraosseous infusion
  program; results published in the Journal of Vascular Access. PortIO relaunched within PAVmed's
  device portfolio in 2026 (investigational; no FDA clearance implied).
* [ReGelTec (HYDRAFIL®)][2] — Spine / Orthopedics, Colombia & Panama — OUS data (75 patients) → CE
  Mark + FDA IDE pivotal trial (first U.S. patient Jun 2025, 225-patient RCT); peer-reviewed results
  in Pain Physician, Jan 2026.
* [enVVeno Medical (enVVe®)][3] — Vascular Surgery, Colombia — LATAM first-in-human foundation →
  first-ever FDA IDE approval for a non-surgical replacement venous valve; U.S. pivotal TAVVE® study
  authorized April 29, 2026. The IDE authorizes the pivotal STUDY in severe deep chronic venous
  insufficiency, not device clearance or approval.
* [Axoft][4] — Neurotechnology, Panama — Panama first-in-human at The Panama Clinic (4 patients
  implanted during brain-tumor resection) → 11 patients implanted worldwide → $55M Series A (April
  2026, led by C.P. Group Innovation; >$60M total raised). FDA Breakthrough Device Designation
  (2022).
* [Mitralign][5] — Structural Heart, Colombia & Brazil — percutaneous mitral annuloplasty program
  advanced in LATAM (company later acquired by Edwards Lifesciences).
* [OcuMedex (Vizio™ Aqueous Microshunt)][6] — Ophthalmology, Colombia — first-in-human clinical
  trials of the Vizio™ Aqueous Microshunt for glaucoma. Investigational device that drains aqueous
  humor from the anterior chamber to the eye's surface for IOP reduction; currently in human
  clinical trials (no FDA clearance implied).
* [Newrotex (SilkAxons™)][7] — Peripheral Nerve Repair, Panama — world's first SilkAxons™
  implantation at The Panama Clinic (FIH began August 2025); investigational silk-based nerve guide
  intended for large-gap peripheral nerve injuries beyond the reach of existing conduits.
* [Watershed Therapeutics][8] — Urology / Drug Delivery, El Salvador & Panama (earlier support in
  Colombia) — bioaccess® secured regulatory and ethics-committee approvals to conduct clinical
  studies of Watershed's novel intravesical bladder-targeted drug-delivery platform (rUTIs,
  overactive bladder, bladder cancer). Investigational; no FDA clearance or approval implied.
* [Avantec Vascular (a Nipro Company)][9] — Cardiovascular / Vascular / Venous, El Salvador, Mexico
  & Colombia — bioaccess® ran the first-in-human / early clinical studies of Avantec's Sangria™
  Venous Remodeling System across El Salvador, Mexico, and Colombia (PI/site selection,
  ministry-of-health regulatory dossier submissions to authorize study conduct, $10M clinical-trial
  insurance, device importation, and FIH execution). Sangria™ is investigational; no FDA clearance,
  approval, CE marking, or commercialization implied.

*Eligibility of foreign clinical data for FDA submission does not constitute or predict FDA
clearance, approval, or acceptance of any specific application.*

## Core Proof Points
* 50+ client companies accelerated since 2010
* 50+ pre-qualified clinical trial sites
* 19 Latin American & Caribbean countries covered
* Ethics-committee approval in a median of 4–8 weeks; the comparable U.S. pathway (IDE + IRB + site
  activation to first patient) typically runs 6–12 months
* Meaningful per-patient savings compared to US/EU trials (experience-based estimate)
* ACRP-certified clinical research team

## Services
* First-in-Human (FIH) Clinical Trials
* Early Feasibility Studies (EFS) for Medical Devices
* Radiopharmaceutical & Theranostics Clinical Trials (Lu-177, Ac-225, Ga-68)
* Medical Device Registration & Market Access (ANVISA, INVIMA, COFEPRIS, ANMAT, ISP, DIGEMID)
* FIH-12™ — 12-month FIH timeline guarantee
* Clinical Trial Site Search & Selection
* Regulatory Strategy & FDA Data Bridge

## Welcome to ClinDM

### Your Partner in Clinical Data Management

We specialize in providing comprehensive Data Management services for pharmaceutical, biotech,
healthcare, and research organizations. Our team of experts is dedicated to delivering accurate and
reliable data analysis to support evidence-based decision making and improve patient outcomes.

[Learn More][8]

#### Comprehensive Data Management Solutions

We offer end-to-end data management solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements of healthcare
organizations and research institutions. From data collection and cleaning to quality control and
analysis, we have the expertise to ensure seamless and accurate management of clinical data.

#### Advanced Technology Infrastructure

Our state-of-the-art technology infrastructure allows us to handle large volumes of data and perform
complex analyses efficiently. We leverage industry-leading software and tools to optimize data
processing and enable real-time access to critical information.

#### Compliance and Security

Data privacy and security are paramount in clinical data management. We adhere to strict regulatory
standards and implement robust security measures to safeguard patient data. Our compliance team
ensures strict adherence to GDPR, HIPAA, and other relevant regulations.

## About Us

### Driving Excellence in Clinical Data Management

At ClinDM, we are passionate about empowering healthcare professionals and researchers with
innovative Data Management solutions. With a focus on accuracy, efficiency, and compliance, we aim
to optimize the collection, storage, and analysis of medical data to facilitate groundbreaking
discoveries and advancements in patient care.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

Better solutions for physicians and patients

## VISION

Developing Better Solutions For Physicians And Patients

Neuraptive is developing novel therapeutics and medical products to address the unmet needs of
physicians and patients impacted by peripheral nerve injuries.

[Illustration of the human arm anatomy representing nerves, bones and ligaments..jpg]

## RESEARCH & TECHNOLOGY

The Future of Peripheral Nerve Repair and Recovery

### PEG-FUSION 

Neuraptive has in-licensed technology from the University of Texas at Austin (UT) protecting a novel
fusion system for repairing severed peripheral nerves. This technology improves both the speed and
outcomes of peripheral nerve injuries (PNI).

[Learn More][13]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 1 Nerve Fusion.png]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 2 Drug Delivery Device.png]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 2 Drug Delivery Device.png]

### DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE

A specialized device focusing on the delivery of active agents for topical administration directly
on the nerve.

[Learn More][14]

### MICROSURGICAL INSTRUMENTS

Neuraptive is developing nerve-specific microsurgical instruments that address current product
limitations in the field of nerve repair.

[Learn More][15]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 3 Microsurgical Instruments.png]

## THE NEURAPTIVE DIFFERENCE

An innovative technology potentially revolutionizing nerve repair.

Neuraptive has developed a surgical treatment kit for peripheral nerves after traumas or peripheral
nerve reconstruction procedures.  NTX-001 leverages the 505(b)(2) development pathway (comprised of
previously approved pharmaceutical ingredients) presented in sterile solutions.

Whether you are a fresher or an experienced professional, [Pharma Recruiter][60] connects you with

[Phoenix CTMS]

Phoenix CTMS is a modern web application combining capabilities of database software used in
clinical research in *one* modular system.
* PRS (Patient Recruitment System)
* CTMS (Clinical Trial Management System)
* CDMS (Clinical Data Management System) – EDC (Electronic Data Capture) Package

This unmatched feature set is geared to support all operational and regulatory requirements of the
clinical front end in academic research, at CROs (Contract Research Organisations) and hospitals
conducting clinical studies of any phase.

After years of collaborative development with trial sites at the [Medical University of Graz][21],
the Phoenix CTMS now becomes publicly available ([LGPL 2.1][22]). It could be the perfect choice if
you e.g.
* need a private, *encrypted* subject registry for PII (personally identifyable information), to
  complement your existing CDMS
* need a solution to comply with upcoming [EU-GDPR][23] (General Data Protection Regulation)
* want to operate a secure online *signup portal* for subject candidates
* must not store the sensitive data in the *cloud*
* are not satisfied with the edit check or form field calculation possibilities available in other
  EDC packages
* want a CDMS that gives you unlimited *Javascript* form scripting support (server- and browserside)
* need to deal with *large* eCRFs (electronic case report forms)
* want to try a serious open source alternative for eCRFs
* need to formulate complex *ad-hoc* database queries to list matching subject candidates using *set
  operations*
* conduct several trials in parallel and need to organize site staff and resources
* need a software to implement various processes for ICH GCP (good clinical practice) compliance
* want a turn-key system that’s operational out-of-the-box, instead of integrating multiple systems

[Phoenix CTMS]

Phoenix CTMS is a modern web application combining capabilities of database software used in
clinical research in *one* modular system.
* PRS (Patient Recruitment System)
* CTMS (Clinical Trial Management System)
* CDMS (Clinical Data Management System) – EDC (Electronic Data Capture) Package

This unmatched feature set is geared to support all operational and regulatory requirements of the
clinical front end in academic research, at CROs (Contract Research Organisations) and hospitals
conducting clinical studies of any phase.

After years of collaborative development with trial sites at the [Medical University of Graz][21],
the Phoenix CTMS now becomes publicly available ([LGPL 2.1][22]). It could be the perfect choice if
you e.g.
* need a private, *encrypted* subject registry for PII (personally identifyable information), to
  complement your existing CDMS
* need a solution to comply with upcoming [EU-GDPR][23] (General Data Protection Regulation)
* want to operate a secure online *signup portal* for subject candidates
* must not store the sensitive data in the *cloud*
* are not satisfied with the edit check or form field calculation possibilities available in other
  EDC packages
* want a CDMS that gives you unlimited *Javascript* form scripting support (server- and browserside)
* need to deal with *large* eCRFs (electronic case report forms)
* want to try a serious open source alternative for eCRFs
* need to formulate complex *ad-hoc* database queries to list matching subject candidates using *set
  operations*
* conduct several trials in parallel and need to organize site staff and resources
* need a software to implement various processes for ICH GCP (good clinical practice) compliance
* want a turn-key system that’s operational out-of-the-box, instead of integrating multiple systems

#### **Delivering Solutions That Drive Healthcare Forward**

## About Us

Founded in 1996 as the SIRO Research Foundation and incorporated in 2000 as SIRO Clinpharm Private
Limited, SIRO brings over two decades of exceptional project management expertise to the table. From
pioneering proof-of-concept trials to managing complex, multinational studies involving rare
diseases, stringent protocols, and accelerated timelines, SIRO has consistently delivered with
precision and reliability. Our win-win philosophy drives us to ensure success for every client.
Today, SIRO stands as a leading provider of drug development and discovery solutions, offering a
diverse and innovative suite of CRO services to global biotech, pharmaceutical, medical device, and
academic institutions. To better serve our clients’ evolving needs, we have strategically
reorganized into three specialized verticals: SIRO Clintech, SIRO Medical Writing, and SIRO
Clinpharm, which continues to offer specialized FSP services.

SIRO Group encompasses three distinct companies, each specializing in unique sectors to provide
comprehensive solutions.

Best-in-class medical writing services, supporting your drug development journey from initial

entire value chain.

## About Us

Founded in 1996 as the SIRO Research Foundation and incorporated in 2000 as SIRO Clinpharm Private
Limited, SIRO brings over two decades of exceptional project management expertise to the table. From
pioneering proof-of-concept trials to managing complex, multinational studies involving rare
diseases, stringent protocols, and accelerated timelines, SIRO has consistently delivered with
precision and reliability. Our win-win philosophy drives us to ensure success for every client.
Today, SIRO stands as a leading provider of drug development and discovery solutions, offering a
diverse and innovative suite of CRO services to global biotech, pharmaceutical, medical device, and
academic institutions. To better serve our clients’ evolving needs, we have strategically
reorganized into three specialized verticals: SIRO Clintech, SIRO Medical Writing, and SIRO
Clinpharm, which continues to offer specialized FSP services.

### Simple

### Fast

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

# Timeline maker for projects and stories

Timetoast is a free online timeline maker for work, school, and personal use. Plan projects, teach
lessons, map life events, and share interactive timelines that are easy to follow.

Used by **millions worldwide** for product launches, roadmaps, lessons, biographies, and historical
overviews.

[Create a timeline][24]
[Screenshot of Timetoast showing a color-coded timeline alongside a connected grid view for managing
timeline details.]

classroom timeline][28] [Create a biography timeline][29] [Prepare for a legal case][30] [Group
timeline events into lanes][31] [Switch between timeline views][32]

## A timeline maker that stays clear as projects and stories grow

Timetoast helps you organize the details behind a project, lesson, or story and turn them into a
timeline that is easier to scan, explain, and share.

[Screenshot of a horizontal timeline with color-coded events laid out automatically.]
See the big picture at a glance
Visual planning

## See the bigger picture on a timeline

Lay out milestones, phases, and events on a clear visual timeline.

Seeing everything in chronological order makes it easier to understand sequence, overlap, and key
moments at a glance.

As your project changes, you can keep adjusting the timeline without losing the overall view.

[Screenshot showing a timeline event assigned to a phase field that can be used for grouping.]
Structured timelines that scale
Structured timelines

## Organize events and details without the mess

Add dates, descriptions, images, links and more. Use custom fields such as status, owner, phase, or
category to keep timeline data structured in a way that fits your project, lesson, or research.
* Capture milestones and important dates
* Add context with notes and media
* Structure events with custom fields

[Screenshot of Timetoast showing color-coded items grouped into lanes on a horizontal timeline.]

Timeline lanes and colors

## Group related events visually

Larger timelines often include parallel tracks. Lanes and colors help you separate teams, phases,
topics, or themes so patterns and relationships are easier to see.
* Organize timelines by team or phase
* Separate parallel topics clearly
* Make larger timelines easier to follow

Clinical Ops

Effective Clinical Operations are the cornerstone of successful drug development. Our dedicated team
of professionals is attuned to the critical nuances that drive clinical trial success, from
meticulous protocol adherence to proactive risk management. We prioritize precision and compliance
at every stage, ensuring your trials proceed with maximum efficiency and regulatory confidence.

Clinical Data Management

At Vita Global Sciences, we understand that the importance of clinical data assets in
pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device industry. Our expert team is committed to ensuring that
your clinical trial data management process: 1) fits your project needs, 2) is highly efficient, and
3) meets the highest standards of integrity and quality by complying with Good Clinical Data
Management Practices (GCDMP) and Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDSIC)
requirements. A team of highly experienced data managers will support all CDM-aspects of our
project, individual trial databases are developed according to your business requirements, data is
being consequently monitored and validated prior to transfer to the formulation level.


Our core competencies in data management comes from our thorough knowledge of standards, our
flexible systems, and the effective use of vividly available data management systems.

Biostatistics

Vita Global Sciences has developed a network of statisticians who are at the cutting-edge of advance
statistical design and analysis, with in-depth expertise across therapeutic areas. Irrespective of
where you are in the product development lifecycle and approval process, Vita Global Sciences can
provide you with the strategic consulting needed in performing/optimizing the trial design and
developing a statistical analysis plan which will detail the safety and efficacy analysis methods
required for securing marketing approval. We also have ample experience in representing the customer
at regulatory body meetings. Our Biostatistics team offers services on complex statistical issues
encountered during study design or analysis. They bring expertise and insights in trial design,
sample size calculations, randomization, interim analyses, developing complex statistical analysis
plans (SAPs), and consulting on adaptive design. They have extensive experience in interacting with
FDA and are actively collaborating with academia, industry and FDA working groups.

provides insightful analysis and clinical study reports that empowers clients to draw
interpretations and make well-informed decisions. A clearly laid out QC procedure helps us to
deliver results on time, and with utmost quality.

# Welcome To WJPR!                                                                                  
                                                                                                    
**WJPR** is a worldwide multidisciplinary, monthly published, open access, peer-reviewed, online    
pharmacy journal. The aim of WJPR is to serve as a means for updating the scientific knowledge of   
the international audience in the pharmaceutical forum.                                             
                                                                                                    
The Journal welcomes the original research articles, review, short communications and case studies  
relevant to the various fields of Pharmaceutical Sciences such as; Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical    
Technology, Biopharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Analysis and Quality         
Assurance, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmacology and Toxicology, Pharmacy Practice includes Hospital    
Community and Clinical Pharmacy, Pharmacognosy and Phytochemistry, Pharmaceutical Microbiology and  
Biotechnology, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmaceutical Marketing Research, and Alternative Medicines. 
                                                                                                    
##### Journal Standards                                                                             
* A broad ranging open access online journal.                                                       
* Eminent editorials from thought out the world.                                                    
* Fast online manuscript submission.                                                                
* Rapid publication high visibility.                                                                
* Our journal indexed in different reputed publisher databases.                                     
* Gives Email/SMS alert updates.
